remarks: Wonderful 4 BR 2 1/2 bath condo just two blocks from RR Station and shopping on Elm St, or one block from Mead Park. Primary BR with full bath and walk-in closet on main floor, with lovely balcony to enjoy sunsets. LR is oversized with fireplace and sliders to balcony. Private dining room adjoins kitchen and big enough to hold 8-10. Sunny eat-in kitchen fully equipped but still cozy. Upstairs there are two BRs with an oversized bathroom where the washer/dryer reside. The 4th BR is better called an office since it is so large at 23 ft.  Downstairs the unfinished basement has an additional 450 sf waiting for the next owner to finish it as a playroom or office. Parking is easy with an indoor garage under the unit with interior access to avoid rain and snow. Additionally, there is a marked space closeby in the parking lot outside.

facts.petsInfo: two dogs up to 75 lbs eac
